pages.text: $(italic)Survival investment. Every class benefits; Vanguard and Paladin can't do without it.$()$(br2)HP, armor toughness, knockback resistance and healing received are attributes and apply immediately. All-resistance (flat % DR) and HP regen run on a KubeJS bridge script (implemented in Phase 1).

pages.title: Nodes
pages.text: $(bold)Max HP$(): raises base max HP. It does not interact with the half-equipment-HP rule for glass cannon classes.$(br2)$(bold)Armor Toughness$(): the standard armor toughness attribute, at its best against high-damage single hits.$(br2)$(bold)Healing Received$() (attributeslib:healing_received): a percentage bonus to every heal you receive.

pages.title: Nodes (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Resilience Branch$(): all-resistance (flat DR %) from KubeJS, stacking with armor at diminishing returns.$(br2)$(bold)Regeneration Branch$(): passive HP regen through tick-based KubeJS healing, applied every 5 seconds.$(br2)$(bold)Fortitude Capstone$(): $(bold)Unbreakable Spirit$(). Once per combat encounter you survive a killing blow at 1 HP, on a 10 min cooldown.
